title: FadeClose
description: Adds a smooth fade-out animation when closing Minecraft, inspired by the game OneShot. Works with the X button, Alt+F4, and the in-game quit button.
body:
## FadeClose
Inspired by the indie game OneShot, this mod adds a smooth fade-out animation whenever you close Minecraft.
Instead of the window abruptly shutting down, it will gradually become transparent and softly disappear — making the closing experience feel polished and satisfying.
## How it works
The fade-out animation triggers no matter how you close the game:

Clicking the X button
Pressing Alt+F4
Using the in-game Quit button

## Compatibility

Minecraft: Java Edition 1.20.1 – 1.20.6
Mod loader: Forge
Side: Client only — no server needed
